$comment: Annotated evaluation corpus for the deterministic safety net. Each entry is an utterance a trial participant might plausibly speak, with the ground-truth urgency a human reviewer would assign. `kind` groups entries so the harness can report where the net is strong and where it is blind — that breakdown is the point of the corpus. Hand-authored against synthetic protocol ONX-301; no real participant speech.
